title: Support
intro: A question, a bug, an account issue? Write to us, we reply directly — no bot, no endless form.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: For any question, bug, or report, write to:

password.a: Use the "Forgot password" link on the login page to set a new one by email.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: In the app: My account → Danger zone → Delete my account. Deletion is immediate and permanent, no need to go through support.

report.q: I want to report a message or block a player
report.a: In the league chat, any message can be reported or its author blocked directly from the app.

bug.a: Write to us at the address above describing what happened, ideally with a screenshot.
